Ladner Rural is the farm and river pocket west and south-west of Ladner village in the City of Delta, including the Westham Island side, and the City publishes no boundary for the name.
Westham Island is reached only by the Westham Island Bridge over Canoe Pass, off River Road west of Ladner — the bridge is the island's only land access
Ladner village and its sub-areas are east, East Delta is beyond them, and Tsawwassen is south.

The inland stock is farm houses and bare agricultural land under the "Agriculture (A)" designation in the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), and A1 Agriculture zoning where that zone applies
The A1 zone is intended for farming, breeding pets, kennels and related uses, and its accessory uses include equestrian facilities to a maximum of 40 permanent stalls accessory to farming

The river stock is float homes on West River Road, several naming the Canoe Pass float-home community and private boat slips in their listing text — that is feed composition from the page itself, not a tenure finding

blocks.text: Ladner Rural: rules that affect buyers

items.t: This section covers what is specific to this pocket's parcels.
Delta's A1 zone permits one farm house per lot at a maximum total floor area of 500 m², on a farm home plate of at most 3,600 m² (5,000 m² where an additional farm house is also on the plate)

One accessory farm dwelling unit per lot is permitted, at 90 m² or less on lots of 40 hectares or less and 186 m² or less on larger lots, on the same farm home plate as the farm house; an additional farm house needs a Professional Agrologist's report on necessity and written ALC approval
A parcel's Agricultural Land Reserve status is checked on the ALC maps by PID or civic address, and the ALC states its online tools are for general reference only
For a float home, the legal structure is the rule that matters and it is not established by listing text

blocks.text: Ladner Rural: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The George C. Reifel Migratory Bird Sanctuary sits at the north end of Westham Island at 5191 Robertson Road, and its own visitor page sets out hours, admission and directions over the bridge from Ladner

A replacement bridge is in early planning: TransLink states it is working with funding partners on a 2027 Investment Plan expected to fund construction of a new Westham Island Bridge, with engineering design work under way
In Delta's agricultural area the ditches and pump stations run in drainage mode in winter and irrigation mode in summer, when ditch water irrigates crops under City control gates
Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, is Fraser Health's community hospital for Delta with 24/7 emergency care, beside Ladner Exchange

blocks.text: Ladner Rural: development and new projects

items.t: Westham Island Bridge replacement — TransLink (bridge owner). STATUS, read 2026-11-03: early planning and engineering design under way; TransLink states it is working with funding partners on a 2027 Investment Plan expected to fund construction of a new bridge, while repair work on the existing bridge continued after its March 29, 2026 reopening

The rural difference is servicing: farm parcels here can sit outside City water and sewer billing entirely, on wells and onsite sewage, while serviced homes are billed on the annual flat rate bill or quarterly metered bills

There is no confirmed bus route on West River Road or Westham Island itself; the pocket's transit is Ladner Exchange. TransLink route 601 runs from Ladner Exchange via Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99 to Bridgeport Station
Route 620 runs from Ladner Exchange via Highway 17A and Highway 17 to the BC Ferries Tsawwassen terminal and to Bridgeport Station

By road, everything on Westham Island crosses the single-lane Westham Island Bridge at River Road — the only land access — which is why the 67-day closure in early 2026 cut the island off from vehicle access

blocks.text: Ladner Rural: risks and due diligence

items.t: Confirm ALR status first: it controls the farm house cap, the accessory dwelling limits and most use permissions, and it is checked parcel by parcel on the ALC maps

Establish the parcel's flood construction level before designing a farm house: Delta's lowland is diked floodplain, the City maintains over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure, and the level is property-specific

For a Westham Island purchase, diligence the bridge: it is the only land access, it reopened March 29, 2026 after a 67-day closure, repair work continued after reopening, and a replacement is only at the planning stage
Get the parcel's ditch, drainage and irrigation position from the City: agricultural ditches switch between drainage and irrigation modes under City control gates

faq.q: Is Ladner Rural the same search as Ladner farms or East Delta?
faq.a: No — on this page, Ladner Rural is its own Paragon sub-area and its whole 11-listing feed is labelled Ladner Rural only, with no East Delta or Westham Island cards; the separate ladner-farms page is the one whose feed spans sub-areas.

faq.q: Why are there float homes on a "Homes & Acreages" page?
faq.a: Because they sit inside the same sub-area: six of the cards read for this file are float homes on West River Road, several naming the Canoe Pass community and boat slips in their listing texts, alongside inland acreage and farm listings on 34B Avenue and 64 Street.

faq.q: How big can a house be on ALR land in Ladner Rural?
faq.a: Delta's A1 zone permits one farm house per lot at a maximum total floor area of 500 m², on a farm home plate of at most 3,600 m² (5,000 m² where an additional farm house is also on the plate).

faq.q: Can a Ladner Rural farm have a second dwelling?
faq.a: Yes, within limits: the A1 zone permits one accessory farm dwelling unit per lot — 90 m² or less on lots of 40 ha or smaller, 186 m² or less on larger lots — on the same farm home plate as the farm house; more than one needs Agricultural Land Commission approval, and an additional farm house needs an agrologist's necessity report plus written ALC approval.
